text: Too terrified to cry out. <break time="0.8s" /> He tried to speak his dead wifes name. <break time="0.8s" /> And to reach across the table. <break time="0.8s" /> But his throat was powerless. <break time="0.8s" /> Then something heavy. <break time="0.8s" /> Was hurled against the table. <break time="0.8s" /> Pushing its edge against his chest. <break time="0.8s" /> And fell to the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> With a thump. <break time="0.8s" /> That shook the whole house. <break time="0.8s" /> There followed a scuffling. <break time="0.8s" /> And a confusion of sounds. <break time="0.8s" /> Impossible to describe. <break time="0.8s" /> And when he groped for the table. <break time="0.8s" /> In the darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> Nothing was there. <break time="0.8s" /> Half mad with terror. <break time="0.8s" /> He seized the loaded rifle that leaned against the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> And fired it into the dark. <break time="0.8s" /> Without aiming at anything. <break time="0.8s" /> By the bright flash. <break time="0.8s" /> He saw an enormous panther. <break time="0.8s" /> Dragging the body of his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Toward the window. <break time="0.8s" /> And then everything went. <break time="0.8s" /> Black and silent again. <break time="0.8s" /> When he came to his senses. <break time="0.8s" /> The sun was high. <break time="0.8s" /> And the forest outside. <break time="0.8s" /> Was full of the cheerful songs of birds. <break time="0.8s" /> The body lay near the window. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the beast had left it. <break time="0.8s" /> Its clothing torn. <break time="0.8s" /> And its long hair in disorder. <break time="0.8s" /> And the ribbon around its wrists was broken. <break time="0.8s" /> Her hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had been tied gently together the night before were now tightly clenched. <break time="0.8s" /> And between her teeth. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a fragment of the animals ear.
